set (CTEST_TEST_FILE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/CTestTestfile-cisstParameterTypesPython.txt)
set (CTEST_TEST_FILE_AUTO ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/CTestTestfile-cisstParameterTypesPython-auto.txt)
file (WRITE ${CTEST_TEST_FILE} "# File generated by CMake, do not modify\n")

set (LIB cisstParameterTypes)
if (CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  foreach (config ${CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES})
    configure_file (${cisst_SOURCE_DIR}/cisstTestsDriver/cisstTestsDriver.py.in
                    ${EXECUTABLE_OUTPUT_PATH}/${config}/cisstParameterTypesTests.py
                    IMMEDIATE @ONLY)
  endforeach (config)
else ()
  configure_file (${cisst_SOURCE_DIR}/cisstTestsDriver/cisstTestsDriver.py.in
                  ${EXECUTABLE_OUTPUT_PATH}/cisstParameterTypesTests.py
                  IMMEDIATE @ONLY)
endif ()

if (WIN32)
  add_custom_target (cisstParameterTypes_CREATE_PYTHON_TESTS_LIST ALL
                     COMMAND ${cisstTestsDriver_BINARY_DIR}/cisstTestsDriverPython.bat ${CMAKE_CFG_INTDIR}
                             ${EXECUTABLE_OUTPUT_PATH}/${CMAKE_CFG_INTDIR}/cisstParameterTypesTests.py ${CTEST_TEST_FILE_AUTO})
else ()
  add_custom_target (cisstParameterTypes_CREATE_PYTHON_TESTS_LIST ALL
                     COMMAND ${Python_EXECUTABLE} ${EXECUTABLE_OUTPUT_PATH}/${CMAKE_CFG_INTDIR}/cisstParameterTypesTests.py
                             -d ${Python_EXECUTABLE} > ${CTEST_TEST_FILE_AUTO})
endif ()

set_property (TARGET cisstParameterTypes_CREATE_PYTHON_TESTS_LIST PROPERTY FOLDER "cisstParameterTypes/tests")

add_dependencies (cisstParameterTypes_CREATE_PYTHON_TESTS_LIST
                  cisstCommonPython
                  cisstOSAbstractionPython
                  cisstMultiTaskPython
                  cisstParameterTypesPython)

file (APPEND ${CTEST_TEST_FILE} "include (\"${CTEST_TEST_FILE_AUTO}\")\n")
set_directory_properties (PROPERTIES TEST_INCLUDE_FILE ${CTEST_TEST_FILE})
